title: Dotnet Enterprise
description: Professional profile for regulated .NET enterprise application work with ADRs, branching, secure AI use, Azure DevOps pipelines, Dev Containers, Docker-based local development and SQL Server development governance.
adds_boundaries: No production secrets, real customer data or sensitive infrastructure access may be exposed to AI agents.
SQL Server credentials must stay in local ignored files, protected pipeline variables or an approved vault; only .env.example placeholders may be committed.
Docker is limited to development usage unless the adopting project records an explicit decision.
Stack-specific .NET, SQL Server, Azure DevOps and Docker rules remain inside this profile or the adopting project instance, never in the neutral core.
adds_quality_gates: Run unit tests for .NET projects before handoff.
Run dependency and secret scanning in the pipeline for release branches.
Validate Dev Container and database bootstrap templates when they are adopted or changed.
neutrality_note: Nothing in this profile leaks domain/stack terms into the protocol core or its *.template.* masters.
